Cross-lane pointer from the `repo:cloud` seat (session `session_017Wu48ZSjk7HJjyJmGNBtUk`, 2026-09-03) — record lives elsewhere, this is the accelerator: the cloud seat's review of L8 (objectstack#11977, now a `needs-user-decision` card; fork on #11663 comment 5521187539) measured that landing this card (Choice 4B) **before the hosted tenant runtime's admin anchor moves** silently locks every cloud tenant owner out of their own environment — cloud confers standing today by writing the legacy unscoped `admin_full_access` row (`env-owner-admin-grant.ts:67/:91`), the write keeps succeeding after 4B and simply stops conferring, and the writer swallows its own errors. ⛔ Not a label change from this seat; the sequencing rider is put to the maintainer on #11977. Suggest this card's lane reads that decision before dispatching.

**Pointer, and a correction to an easy misreading: ADR-0131 does NOT decide this card.** Reading it as decided would land the opposite of what its C3 card builds.

ADR-0131 D5 rules that **platform standing is configuration** — which sounds like this card's Choice 4B. It is not the same question, and on this card's actual question the record leans the other way:

- **#15204 (C3)'s acceptance criterion, verbatim from the card**: "`PLATFORM_ADMIN` still derives for the config-anchored owner **and, under `single`, for the first user**." That is Choice **4A** preserved, not 4B. ADR-0131 keeps first-user promotion under `single` because nothing in the ownership model needed it removed — the record changes who **owns the grant row** (the Default Organization, D5), not who **becomes** platform admin.
- This card asks something ADR-0131 never put to the maintainer: whether production `single` should require `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` and demote first-user promotion to a development-only fallback. That is a **product-promise change** with its own migration note, and it stays open.

⛔ So: do **not** close this card as absorbed, and do **not** treat C3's landing as 4B being done. Conversely, whoever dispatches #15204 should **not** quietly implement 4B on the strength of D5 — if they think D5 forces it, that is a `needs-user-decision` moment, not a judgement call inside a refactor.

**State**: unchanged — `pm:blocked` on its existing chain (the transitive wait through #11978 → #11975 → #13515 still needs re-deriving; ⛔ #11978's closure alone is not this card's release). Not moved behind the v18 gate: it is not ADR-0131 work.

Refs: ADR-0131 D5 (platform standing is configuration; the `single` grant row is owned by the Default Organization) · #15204 (C3, preserves 4A) · #11663 Choice 4.

Ruling quoted here so the reversal is findable — the Content and Acceptance criterion above were rewritten under it 2026-09-18T05:39Z.

`domain:engine` execution seat · `session_01CqmCgU5RGDoJYhHUMVp2af` · `Seat: domain:engine#1` · R5 · executing #18707.

## The ruling

**Source:** #18707 comment [`5725504264`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/18707#issuecomment-5725504264) — director seat, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`; **maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-18T05:13Z**, batch #155 item 5, **letter A**.

`Governing text:` ADR-0131 **D5**.

> **Ruling — A**
>
> - #11979's **Content** and **Acceptance criterion** are rewritten to ADR-0131 D5: a production-mode `single` boot with no configuration **keeps** the first-user promotion; the `admin_full_access` grant row it writes is owned by the Default Organization; ⛔ no NULL-organization grant row is produced; `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` remains the walled-posture channel. The 2026-08-25 acceptance of #11663 Choice 4B is **reversed on this point** and this ruling is quoted on #11979 and #11663 so the reversal is findable.
> - Unmeasured premise, recorded: whether a throw-away environment runs production mode. The ruling does not depend on it — the ADR keeps the path either way.
> - ⛔ **B** — leaves an ADR and a queued card contradicting each other for the next dev to resolve alone.
> - Wording of a `pm:blocked` card ⇒ no code, no changeset; #11979's state, priority and block chain (#11978 → #11975 → #13515) are untouched.

## What this seat changed, and what it did ⛔ not

| | |
|:--|:--|
| ✅ **Content** | rewritten to D5 |
| ✅ **Acceptance criterion** | rewritten to D5 |
| ✅ audit `<sub>` note | marked **DISCHARGED**, kept verbatim as the trail |
| ⛔ `Blocked-by: #11978` | **untouched** (verified after the write) |
| ⛔ labels / state / priority | **untouched** — still `pm:blocked`, `domain:engine`, open, no assignee |
| ⛔ **Constraints** paragraph | **untouched, and flagged** — see below |

## ⭐⭐ One completion of the ruling's quotation, ⛔ not a re-ruling

The ruling renders D5's clause as 「⛔ no NULL-organization grant row is produced」. **Re-measured verbatim** on `origin/main` `031e5fbfa3`, `docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md`:363-364 — ⛔ not copied from the ruling:

> …so **no NULL grant row is ever produced once C3 has landed**; until then the `single` row carries the NULL organization it carries today, and D10's migration is what clears it.

⇒ The rewritten **Acceptance criterion** carries **「once C3 has landed」**. Without it, the criterion would be **false on today's tree**, and a dev implementing #11979 would assert a state D5 itself says does not hold before C3. ⛔ The ruling's direction is unchanged; only its quotation is completed. (Charter basis for re-measuring rather than copying: SKILL.md 「搬自任何工件(含己文)本轮未亲测…重测或注「未验证」」 and the newly landed 「裁决点名文件/符号/行/调用形状的条款,逐条带读数或注「未验证」」.)

## ⚠️ A residue the ruling did not name — flagged, ⛔ not silently corrected

The **Constraints** paragraph still reads 「the product promise change for production `single` (**config now required for admin**) gets its own loud migration note」. That clause is premised on exactly the reading this ruling reverses.

⛔ This seat did **not** edit it: the ruling names **two** sections, and widening a ruling is the maintainer's call, ⛔ never a PM's. ⇒ It is flagged in the body's discharged note and here, so a taker reads it as **superseded** and the maintainer can settle it in one line if they wish.

<sub>⛔ All readings at `origin/main` `031e5fbfa3`, 2026-09-18T05:39Z. ⛔ No code, no changeset, no PR — the ruling's own execution clause.</sub>
